highlights.title: Contact number in your profile
highlights.description: Save your phone number with your employee details. Timesheets use it automatically; Home keeps it private.

highlights.title: Full-day Comp-Off with clear reasons
highlights.description: Comp-Off uses full days and verified, unused holiday credits. Its reason fills automatically and cannot be edited; backups check the same rules.

releaseNotes: Contact Number is now part of Employee Profile. Comp-Off is full-day only with an automatic, locked holiday reason. CSV backups and HR Excel export validate the selected holiday credits.
